name: Intro to GBrain: AI Memory That Doesn't Forget
description: Discover how GBrain gives AI agents persistent, queryable memory — from its two-zone architecture and entity cross-referencing to autonomous brain maintenance and zero-config deployment.

name: Building a Second Brain with GBrain: Compiled Intelligence in Practice
description: A practical walkthrough for building a second brain using GBrain — covering compiled truth vs timeline, storage and retrieval via BrainEngine, handling updates with APPEND/REWRITE, and scaling the system with async sub-agents and production workflows.
